status: manual, approved by Paul in PR review
description: Reviewed aliases for clubs that are plainly the same team but could not be linked by fixture evidence (european_backfill.derive_names, european_backfill.domestic_aliases). Unlike docs/audits/european-backfill-aliases.json and european-domestic-aliases.json, these are manual: each was proposed from the spellings, the club's country and its history, not derived from shared fixtures, and is approved only in PR review. Harness only (European mode): the live pipeline does not read this file. An alias is an identity mapping (which club a name means), never a fitted or chosen quantity: since 12 Nov 2026 it links names in every European fixture, holdout fixtures included, and no result of any fixture is read to make or apply it. The UCL renames touch only backfilled rows (all before 21 Jan 2025), so every European result row on or after 21 Jan 2025 is byte-identical.

scope_history.approved: Paul, in PR review of the Phase 2c alias review (PR #160)

scope_history.scope: all European fixtures, holdout fixtures included (the 2025-01-21 limit removed)
scope_history.approved: Paul approved this on 12 Nov 2026, before any European holdout scoring (evaluation/european_holdout_ledger.json has no entry)
scope_history.reason: The limit left holdout fixtures of Galatasaray SK and Fenerbahçe SK without domestic form although an alias is an identity mapping. Lifting it changes name linking only: holdout result rows stay byte-identical, and no holdout result trains, fits or chooses anything.

ucl_names.description: Older UCL backfill name (OpenFootball, 2015/16-2022/23) -> the football-data.org name the live UCL loader uses. The backfilled rows are renamed; the club is then one team to the model across 2022/23 -> 2023/24. Every backfilled row is before 21 Jan 2025.

Dinamo Zagreb.reason: GNK (Građanski nogometni klub) is the club's legal prefix; the only Zagreb club in the UCL in these seasons.

Olympiakos Piraeus.reason: PAE Olympiakos SFP is the legal name of Olympiacos of Piraeus; the only Olympiakos in the UCL.

Slavia Praha.reason: Same club with its SK (sportovní klub) prefix.

Qarabağ FK.reason: Qarabağ FK of Ağdam (playing in Baku); the only Qarabağ club.

AEK Athen.reason: AEK Athens, PAE (football company) prefix; the only AEK in the UCL (AEK Larnaca is Cypriot and never in the UCL proper).

domestic.description: European name -> football-data.co.uk domestic name, used by the European domestic-form lookups (european_results.domestic_identities) after the research resolver and the fixture-evidence aliases. Looked up by exact name or reviewed Europa key, like european-domestic-aliases.json. Applied to every European fixture (since 12 Nov 2026; before that, only to fixtures before 21 Jan 2025).

Galatasaray SK.sources: football-data.org UCL (and backfill via the reviewed link Galatasaray -> Galatasaray SK) / football-data.co.uk T1
Galatasaray SK.reason: SK (Spor Kulübü) suffix; the only Galatasaray in Süper Lig. No source spells it 'Galatasaray SK' in domestic fixtures, so no fixture evidence exists.

Fenerbahçe SK.reason: SK suffix and the ç; the only Fenerbahçe in Süper Lig. Its UCL rows are all after 21 Jan 2025, so it links only fixtures from then on (holdout and retrospective).

İstanbul Başakşehir.reason: football-data.co.uk spells İstanbul Başakşehir (formerly İstanbul Büyükşehir Belediyespor) 'Buyuksehyr'; the only Başakşehir in Süper Lig.

Bor. Mönchengladbach.reason: Borussia Mönchengladbach, abbreviated both ways; the only Mönchengladbach club in the Bundesliga.

VfL Wolfsburg.reason: VfL prefix; the only Wolfsburg club in the Bundesliga.

Leicester City.sources: OpenFootball UCL 2016/17; UEL 'leicester city' (reviewed Europa key, 2020/21-2021/22) / football-data.co.uk E0
Leicester City.reason: football-data.co.uk drops 'City'; the only Leicester club in the Premier League.
